name: EFLeverVault flash-loan balance inflation
summary: EFLeverVault authenticated receiveFlashLoan() only by requiring Balancer as caller, so anyone could ask Balancer to invoke its withdrawal branch and release leveraged collateral as ETH. withdraw() then sent the vault's entire ETH balance to one share holder instead of that holder's proportional amount.
notes: The anchor is a front-runner's copy of the original attacker's transaction, which reverted in the same block; both are unaffiliated.
The vault's loss is its leveraged position: aSTETH collateral released minus the WETH debt repaid (a liability, netted per rule 11); Curve stETH slippage paid by the vault is included.
The second attacker's 0.1 ETH deposit, made one transaction before its drain, is the attacker's own money and is netted out, like in-transaction deposits.
